lede: The school board votes Monday on a flood-related budget appropriation for FY 2026-27 — real money being redirected because this summer's flooding hit TIS, TMHS, and the Palm Theatre hard. Alongside that, the Ethics Commission takes up whether Telluride should establish a formal Code of Conduct for town officials, the County Commissioners dig into what CCAP childcare funding cuts mean for the county budget, and the Telluride Hospital District board could act on a Two Site Model that would shape what the new medical facility looks like and where it gets built.

notable.stake: Board votes on flood-driven budget appropriation reshaping district spending for FY 2026-27.
Commission drafts Code of Conduct recommendation for Town Council on official accountability.
CCAP childcare funding shortfall could shift county budget priorities and human services spending.
Board may act on Two Site Model, determining scope and location of the new medical facility.
TMVOA votes on workforce housing committee formation and updated association policies.
